content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-13: Fresh paw-smoothed mud slopes down to the brook where yesterday there was only a steep cut bank; small tracks go all the way to the water. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY tested the new mud ramp, slipped once, then used it to reach sweet grass at the waterline.
content.branch_b_path: YY measured the ramp by paw-lengths for Mira, then admitted the mud had measured him back.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: Fresh paw-smoothed mud slopes down to the brook where yesterday there was only a steep cut bank; small tracks go all the way to the water.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
